ns2:section.sectionText: This online version of IB 105 is taught within the Learn@Illinois course management system. There are no classroom sessions. This section is an accelerated 8-week course that will require a larger time commitment per week than the traditional 16-week course. All assessments will be conducted online. There are weekly assignments, projects, and quizzes, and two mid semester exams. There is no final exam. Further information at: http://www.life.illinois.edu/ib/105/online/fall/. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $409.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
